products.name: Baichuan
products.note: Chinese open-source LLM; medical and legal fine-tunes; cross-border data review advised

profile_text.body:
Baichuan AI is a Chinese artificial intelligence company whose website describes its mission as helping the general public easily and equitably access world knowledge and professional services. The company states it is committed to building what it calls China's best large model foundation through breakthroughs in language AI.

The company's primary product is Baichuan, a Chinese open-source large language model that includes fine-tuned variants for medical and legal domains. Users handling cross-border data are advised to review applicable requirements before use. No litigation, MCP server registrations, SEC filings, or patent records are held for the company at this time.
